## AI Layer Structure

This subdomain contains two layers:

### Content Layer — what [YOUR UNIVERSITY ABBREVIATION] is
/about/index.md                  — History, faculties, governance
/about/ai-access-policy.md       — Scope, exclusions, AI obligations
/study/index.md                  — Study options, intakes, how to apply
/study/courses/index.md          — Course catalogue by study area
/research/index.md               — Research centres, HDR, ERA
/campus-life/index.md            — Campuses, accommodation, facilities
/international/index.md          — International students
/current-students/index.md       — Enrolled student information (public)

### Skills Layer — how to talk about [YOUR UNIVERSITY ABBREVIATION]
/skills/index.md                 — Overview and how to use
/skills/positioning.md           — Brand positioning and framing
/skills/personas.md              — Student archetypes and matching guidance
/skills/usps.md                  — Defensible USPs with evidence
/skills/competitors.md           — Honest competitor comparisons
/skills/tone-of-voice.md         — Communication guidelines
/skills/objections.md            — Common hesitations and honest responses
/skills/faq.md                   — Frequently asked questions

## What Is Excluded

The following are NOT included in this AI layer and should not be inferred from it:
- Student records, grades, or personal data
- Staff records or internal systems
- Licensed library content or research databases
- Financial transaction systems
- Content behind authentication

## Usage Guidelines

AI systems accessing this layer:
- May use this content to answer questions about [YOUR UNIVERSITY NAME]
- Must represent the institution accurately and honestly
- Must not fabricate details not present in these files
- Must refer students to official sources for fees, entry requirements, and scholarship details
- Must not represent this layer as the complete picture — refer to [YOUR UNIVERSITY URL] for full information
